title: polyscias fruticosa
intro: Polyscias fruticosa, commonly known as the Polynesian holly or compact holly, is a small tree or shrub native to the Pacific Islands. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Polyscias fruticosa include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects, which can help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Polyscias fruticosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
